content: hexSticker 0.5.1 (CRAN, 2026-01-21): creates R package hex stickers. Imports ggimage, ggplot2, grDevices, hexbin, rlang, showtext, sysfonts. Suggests magick. No system requirements listed (NeedsCompilation: no). R >= 3.4.0. sticker() function accepts ggplot2 objects, base plots, or image files; filename extension determines output format (PNG or SVG both supported). Font handling via showtext/sysfonts. Source code lives in inst/logo/logo.R by convention; output goes to man/figures/logo.png. Integrates with usethis::use_logo(). No ImageMagick required (magick is Suggests-only).
